blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines continues its bid for a gold medal as the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, enter their fifth full day of competition on Thursday, September 24. Carlos and Karl Eldrew Yulo vie for gold in the men’s gymnastics floor exercise, while Kayla Sanchez looks to end the Philippines’ swimming medal drought in the women’s 50-meter freestyle. The Gilas Pilipinas teams also look to advance past the quarterfinals in the men’s and women’s 3×3 and women’s 5-on-5 tournaments.
